items.html: *And you must know that besides the difference that there is between pregnancy, nursing, and Gadlut in the matter of the Daat, as above, so there is a difference between them in the matter of the other two Mochin. For even though they exist in him, they are not complete, because the light of the Daat, which enlarges them, is lacking from them. Therefore, in the Mochin of Hochma, the expansion of the thirty-two paths of Hochma was not yet recognizable in him, and in the Mochin of Bina, the expansion of the fifty gates of Bina was not recognizable, and also the Daat was not divided into the corridors and chambers mentioned in the Idra of Naso, page 137. But all these aspects were then still in potentiality and not in actuality and in detail.
